title: Route Lease Integration (surface plane + failover + checker)
rationale: Spec 019 (surface plane) defines the lease FSM. ADR-0030 (route failover) defines replan(). This spec wires the two: when the underlying RouteStep fails, the surface lease transitions Pending/Active -> Failed (with LeaseExitReason::HostFailure); when replan() succeeds the surface is re-bound silently (history grows, handle is stable); when replan() returns NoReplacement the surface is Failed and the user is told to re-admit. This is the integration spec PF-WP-017 (workspace persistence) blocks on.
acceptance_signals: fabric_graph::leases::rebind_or_fail(lease, plan, intent, failed_nodes) -> Result<SurfaceLease, SurfaceError> exists and is exercised by integration tests
failover::replan() returning FailoverOutcome::NoReplacement causes surface lease to transition to Failed with LeaseExitReason::HostFailure (single-call path)
failover::replan() returning FailoverOutcome::Replaced(new_plan) causes surface lease to be silently re-bound (current -> history, new binding installed, handle stable, state remains Active)
cmd/checker -failover-blacklist <node-id> rejects the host with ReasonBlacklisted severity Block, before any resource comparison
Strict epoch binding surface invalidates when SurfaceSpec::strict_epoch_binding is true and the topology epoch drifts between bind and re-bind
